warning: Hypothetical branch checks only. These are not real implementation, approval, CI or deployment evidence and must never authorize external execution.

cases.given: General planning only; current slice decisions resolved; future separate requirements deferred; matching independent plan review evidence assumed within this simulation.
cases.expected: Planning-only completion may pass increment-plan-review; implementation/release N/A with reason.

cases.given: Current slice depends on an unresolved permission or architecture decision.
cases.expected: Block implementation and return to parent; do not silently decide in implementer.

cases.given: Product-planner chooses screen layout and interaction details without ui-ux-designer.
cases.expected: Fail role/UI gate compliance and request specialist planning.

cases.given: Assignment is revision 2, referenced plan now revision 3 and impact includes requested interface.
cases.expected: Recipient returns blocked before edits; parent revises scope/reviews/reissues assignment.

cases.given: Worker completes code and directly assigns a deployment worker or marks final approval.
cases.expected: Reject routing/verdict boundary; return evidence to parent for independent review.

cases.given: Frontend/backend implementation evidence passes, but user did not request deployment.
cases.expected: Implementation can complete; release not-requested, no fabricated deploy pass or unnecessary approval.

cases.given: Release reviewed commit A; CI success evidence belongs to different commit B.
cases.expected: Readiness fails even for manual dispatch; no operational execution.

cases.given: All readiness criteria hypothetically pass and parent authorization covers exact release operation; deployment has not run.
cases.expected: Release-ready only, never deployed/complete; execute only under complete release assignment.

cases.given: Deploy returns exit 2 and recovery fails.
cases.expected: Operator-action-required with preserved evidence; no completion and no blind repeated deploy.

cases.given: Previous application can run with current schema; rollback selected but database restore has not been authorized.
cases.expected: Only authorized app rollback allowed; do not infer DB restore approval.

cases.given: Process resumes after implementation review, before release observation, with unchanged plan/contract/SHA.
cases.expected: Load current increment, verified review and release evidence, resume next incomplete phase without repeating completed work.

cases.given: User feedback changes priority and scope for a future increment.
cases.expected: Product-planner revises bounded plan/priorities, records impact; this is not adaptive harness self-improvement.

cases.given: Required OAuth callback registration/tenant permission is missing; code integration assumes that external setup exists.
cases.expected: Stop affected implementation before dependent edits or activation; return sanitized blocker, external owner, concrete setup options and exact resume checks. Do not fabricate config or disable auth.

cases.given: The parent explicitly assigned offline API contract tests using a known contract and labeled test doubles; live credentials are unavailable.
cases.expected: Complete only independent authorized offline scope; live activation remains blocked and tests never count as live integration success.

cases.given: Goal-mode continuation resumes with the same known external permission blocker and no new evidence.
cases.expected: Keep task blocked without retrying side effects, provider switch or scope expansion. Follow runtime status semantics without claiming an unavailable pause operation.

cases.given: External owner supplies changed setup evidence for the correct target and the parent confirms a current revised assignment.
cases.expected: Verify readiness and affected downstream review validity, preserve old failure evidence, then resume only the authorized formerly blocked work.
